claims.summary: For a finite nonempty multiset of points rho = sigma_0 + i gamma on one vertical line, total multiplicity n, F(s) = prod (s - rho)^m and Q(s) = F(s+1)/F(s): (1) if n = 1 then Re Q > 0 on Re s > sigma_0; (2) if n >= 2 there is s with Re s > sigma_0 and Re Q(s) < 0; (3) if the lowest point is simple, the residue of Q there is the product of (1 + i/d)^m over the other points, d their height differences, and for three simple points its real part is 1 - 1/(d_1 d_2), negative exactly when d_1 d_2 < 1.
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof: on the line just below the lowest point every factor 1 + 1/(s - rho) has argument arctan(1/(d + eta)) in (0, pi/2), their sum is continuous in eta and exceeds pi/2 near eta = 0 when n >= 2, so it passes through (pi/2, pi). The ratio is the one whose nonnegative real part is the necessary consequence of the second positivity condition in Conrey and Li (arXiv math/9812166, Theorem 2), so, given that theorem (read, not checked), no map as in it satisfies the positivity in a finite model of the hypothesis with two or more points on the line. Says nothing about xi; no novelty.
claims.rationale: Shows that the necessary consequence of one positivity condition the record's lead named fails in a model where the zero-free statement holds, for points on one line.
